blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines —Voter registration resumes on Tuesday, November 10, for the May 2028 elections, with eligible Filipinos given until July 30, 2027, to register, according to the Commission on Elections (Comelec). The registration period allows first-time voters to register, existing voters to transfer their registration records, and those with deactivated records to reactivate their status. […]...
